# TruncAI-OTiX

> Public D0 overview of an internally executable, local, synthetic and non-operational technical reference for bounded, human-reviewed AI decision support, traceability and controlled technical evaluation.

Canonical website: https://truncaiotix.com/
Official public repository: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public
Language: English
Contact: contact@truncaiotix.com

## Public access

- The canonical website and this summary are public D0 material.
- The official public repository contains the approved D0 website snapshot, README and publication log: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public
- They require no authentication, cookies or client-side JavaScript to retrieve their textual content.
- Automated readers are allowed by robots.txt.
- Technical source and evaluation artefacts are not public; approved evaluators may receive a scoped D2 package under explicit authorisation and appropriate confidentiality terms.

## Public verification links

- Repository: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public
- Public disclosure README: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public/blob/main/README.md
- D0 publication log: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public/blob/main/PUBLICATION-LOG.md
- Versioned website snapshot: https://github.com/truncai-otix/TruncAI-OTiX-public/tree/main/site

## Current baseline

- Version: V2.1.
- Status: internally executable transferable baseline with explicit limitations.
- Environment: local, synthetic and non-operational.
- Maximum authorised capability: C2 RECOMMEND.
- Prohibited capabilities: C3 PREPARE / ISSUE and C4 EXECUTE / CONTROL.
- Human ownership and review remain mandatory.

## Evidence components

- Evidence Spine: versioned contracts, deterministic canonicalisation, SHA-256 records, linked append-only events, replay, manifests and integrity checks.
- Agent Governance: identity, human ownership, minimum-privilege delegation, purpose and tool binding, validity, budgets, revocation and HITL escalation.
- Assurance Lab: deterministic synthetic evaluation campaigns, negative testing, tamper detection and replay.
- Baseline Closure: machine-readable closure and fail-closed checks against silent expansion of authority, validation scope or claims.

## Internal verification snapshot

- G7.1 Evidence Spine: 40/40 INTERNAL PASS.
- G7.2 Agent Governance: 26/26 INTERNAL PASS.
- G7.3 Assurance Lab: 30/30 INTERNAL PASS.
- G7.4 Baseline Closure: 17/17 INTERNAL PASS.
- Additive total: 113/113 internal tests for the recorded object, fixtures, version and environment.
- E08 industrial continuity: INCONCLUSIVE and not counted as PASS.
- E10 real human supervision: INCONCLUSIVE and not counted as PASS.

## Applied evidence path

- The frozen V2.0 Energy Advisory demonstrator is the only current domain with project-specific applied evidence.
- It analyses historical telemetry locally and provides read-only recommendations for human review.
- It does not control inverters, batteries, protection, grid, loads or other operational assets.
- Private real-energy data is excluded from public disclosure.

## Claim boundary

- No external or industrial validation is claimed.
- No certification, regulatory conformity or production readiness is claimed.
- No absolute security, complete threat coverage or functional safety is claimed.
- No proven cost, energy, emissions, forecasting or anomaly-detection benefit is claimed.
- Potential regulatory relevance depends on intended purpose, classification, actor role and deployment context and requires competent external legal and sectoral assessment.

## Evaluation

The progressive path is public overview, scoped review, synthetic clean-room evaluation, confidential review and—only when justified and authorised—evaluation with third-party data. Portability to a third party's real environment has not yet been demonstrated.
